opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Generally £1,500-£5,000; exceptionally up to £6,000. Travel: up to £2,000 per person (trips up to 13 days) or £2,500 per person (14 days+); up to £5,000 for PhD fieldwork visits of six months or more (UK office); Japan office up to ¥300,000 for PhD students.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. No grants to individuals for personal projects. Projects originating in the UK go through the UK office; those in Japan through the Japan office. No undergraduate or master's students; PhD students may apply.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK-Japan collaborative projects that deepen mutual understanding, encourage exchange of ideas or expertise, or develop lasting collaboration between the two nations. Open to any field including arts and culture, humanities and social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

deadlines.raw: 1 December (annual, for decision in March of following year)

amount.raw: Up to £10,000 per year; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to health and medical professionals, researchers, practitioners, policy makers, managers and voluntary sector workers in Japan and the UK. The project must involve partners in both the UK and Japan and must be supported by reputable referees not based at the same institution as either project partner. Preference given to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration and to early-career applicants. Apply to the UK (London) office.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs.
